item.title: Sweet Cubby Recalls Children's Loungewear Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Children's Sleepwear
item.company: Dongguan Hongtu Sports Goods Co. Ltd., of China
item.brand: Dongguan Hongtu Sports Goods Co. Ltd., of China
item.summary: This recall involves all Sweet Cubby children's loungewear sets. The recalled two-piece loungewear sets consist of a short-sleeved shirt and matching shorts. The sets were sold in various colors and in children's sizes 5-6Y through 13-14Y. "Batch No.: 272779" and the size are printed on the sewn-in neck label and on the seam label.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Victgoal Children’s Bike Helmets.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
